code_examples.text:
iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

PSC::lease_time
       Get the session lease time.

SYNOPSIS
       PSC::lease_time IP_ADDR (LEASE_TIME)?

DESCRIPTION
       The PSC::lease_time command gets the lease time of the session.

       Syntax

       PSC::lease_time

	   * Retrieve the session lease time.

RETURN VALUE
       Return the session lease time.

VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.6.0 --First introduced the command.
